messages:
sam: AM roundup — prewarmed us-west-2 pools and drained 3 nodes in pool-g2 for the kernel patch. Observed ~12% bump in queue latency at peak, but throughput steady. Noticed 2 pending spot terminations in eu-west-1; pinging @lina for quota / fallback options. PR for scheduler change is up: #4521.

lina: saw the eviction alerts earlier. We currently have 18 spare vGPU slots in eu-west-1 but az-b is tight. Filed a temporary quota increase request CLOUD-REQ-987 (ETA ~2h). If that stalls we can shift some prewarm to us-east-1 for the next 3 hours.

raj: ran the autoscaler canary last night — metrics looked fine overall but one host OOM'ed during the tail end of a batch job. Root cause points to liveness probe timing with the new batch flag. Filed ENG-2123 for the repro and suggested rollback threshold. Blocker: need decision whether to roll forward or revert the canary.

marta: on PR review for pool-scheduler (PR #4521). Noticed default batching flag changed behavior; we should update private deployment config before promoting. I'll land a staging patch first.

ops-bot: spot-signal: eu-west-1a -> 2 imminent evictions detected. Suggested fallback target: dedicated-queue-eu.

sam: ack. I'll trigger fallback routing for EU lanes at 09:18 UTC. Can someone confirm capacity in dedicated-queue-eu for 2 GPUs?

lina: confirmed — dedicated-queue-eu has 6 free GPUs right now. Reserving 2 and updating routing policy; done. :white_check_mark:

raj: telemetry FYI — prefix-cache hit rate dropped ~8% after the autoscaler canary rolled in. I'm tracking correlations with batch size and sequence length.

marta: today's plan: finish PR review, push config bump to staging, monitor prewarm queues across regions. Blocker: need infra approver on CLOUD-REQ-987 to avoid cross-AZ shift.

sam: if approval stalls I'll spin a controlled warmup in us-east-1 to absorb EU spill for the next 2 hours and keep latency SLO. Pinging ops on-call for handover.

deploy-bot: deploy queued -> pool-scheduler/0.9.1 -> staging at 10:05 UTC.

sam: cool — keep me posted. If anyone sees >15% latency bump after fallback, call it out here and we'll rollback routing.

lina: will post CLOUD-REQ-987 approval link when granted.

marta: quick tip for debugging spikes: run `make capacity-report && ./tools/format-report.sh` and paste the output here if you see anomalous host churn.

sam: thx all. :thumbsup:
